title: Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program Payment Plans: Number of Payments by Balance
content:
The balance scale of a Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program payment plan sets the number of payments from the enrollment's open balance on the day of the payment. The open balance is every charge posted on the enrollment less every payment, Workforce Solutions remittance and credit posted on it.

| Open balance | Payments set by the scale |
|---|---|
| at least 300.00 | 4 |
| at least 150.00 and less than 300.00 | 3 |
| at least 50.00 and less than 150.00 | 2 |
| less than 50.00 | 1 |

## Boundaries

| Open balance | Payments |
|---|---|
| 49.99 | 1 |
| 50.00 | 2 |
| 149.99 | 2 |
| 150.00 | 3 |
| 299.99 | 3 |
| 300.00 | 4 |
| 1,040.00 | 4 |
